notes.title: Hand Cannon Relaunch Part 1! New mechanics first pass
notes.content:
Hello!

So sorry this update comes so late and so randomly.

Wanted to cover one thing first which is that I owe everyone a big apology for the sudden lack of updates and radio silence.

TL;DR, after early access started I got my first job in games. It ended up being hard to balance the new job and this solo project so I sort of just fell off the wagon.

I do think I've found a good balance now and don't anticipate this being an issue going forward but wanted to apologize. Thank you all for your interest in the game, I am still very much committed to finishing it and will do my best to communicate in a prompt and straight-forward fashion going forward.

Now, on to the fun stuff!

[b]What's in this update?[/b]

This update basically contains a solid chunk of iteration on what I'm starting to think of as a "remastered" version of the game and the base of what I'm planning to iterate on for the full release.

I don't think the new pass is in a totally "fun" state yet but I wanted to get it out in the open so I can start hammering on it with feedback from folks who are interested.

[b]If you hate it, and would prefer to play the old version of the game, I've created a beta branch called [b]archive[/b] and frozen the old version of the game there.[/b] If you want to play the old version, you can just switch over to that beta branch to play the old build while I polish up this new pass.

At a super duper high level, here is what's new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/22f7a18e35e42d67bb1b9dbd82f922c976d0ee65.png[/img]

[b]Combat[/b]
* Your weapon cards are now something you actively draw into a hand and then play to equip weapons, invoke powers, modify your weapons, etc.
* You cycle through cards with the top buttons (Y and B on Oculus) and press trigger to play one.
* When you play a weapon card, it now actually changes the appearance of your hand cannon
* Weapons now have unique, animated models that set them apart (e.g. the rocket launcher looks different from the pistol)
* Tried to make weapons feel better to use (added haptics, bullet holes that get left behind, cleaner looking reticles, punchier particle effects, and unique animations).
* Added ammunition that gets used up (so you need to continue to play your cards to equip new weapons, reload, etc.)
* Added new Mod Cards that let you modify your weapon's effects, for example:
  * Flaming Hot - make your weapon apply burn damage.
  * Double Barrel - makes your weapon file another projectile each round.
  * Ricochet - makes your rounds reflect off of walls once (stacks).
* And a lot, lot more stuff, I can't even remember lol.

[b]Locomotion:[/b]
* Kept flying essentially the same but added new thruster models + particle effects that hopefully look cooler
* Expanded the "traditional" locomotion options to include crouching, sprinting, sliding (crouch when sprinting), and wall-running.
* Tried to make jumping and non-flying locomotion feel better in general.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/8787b02e32c667e55c84063c994f6d426f888b97.png[/img]
[b]Levels[/b]
* Started iterating on levels that look a little less low poly.
* Art is still like totally block out/placeholder, but I think it's a bit closer to the level of detail I'd like to hit for 1.0 than what was in there before.
* Also added new hazards like buzz saws, alarm systems, and more.
* Will continue to iterate on these.

...And lots lots more stuff I'm sure I'm forgetting.

While I'm excited about all of this progress, I think the current state of the new build is still pretty rough.

It is super prototype-y and missing tons of functionality I want to add in the next few updates.

That said, just wanted to get this out there to get back in the habit of regular updates and to keep you all in the loop.

If you'd like to discuss the changes, please consider joining the Discord or posting to the forums!

I'll be on there making time to discuss ideas, record bugs, feedback, etc.

Thank you all for your continued support, excited to be back in the swing of things.

notes.title: Patch 12-30
notes.content:
First part of a broader refresh of the game's lore.

Will post more detailed notes in next full content update!

* Game now takes place at the Twilight Tower (no longer an academy. I was sort of finding that setting to be limiting)

notes.title: Update: Boss fights overhaul - health bars, new attacks, and lots of bug fixes
notes.content:
Howdy all!

Hope you all have enjoyed the holidays :^)

Just shipped a big update today, it's all about [b][i]boss fights[/i][/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/c99cd1536111224a11da9e42210d61e95503cc2f.png[/img]

[h1]What's New[/h1]
[h2]Boss Fight Overhaul[/h2]
The game's boss fights were feeling unpolished and buggy relative to the rest of the game, so I gave them a fresh coat of paint. I think the boss fights feel more challenging now but at the same time more fair because they are less buggy.

[b]General improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Bosses now have health bars.
[*] Bosses now play an animation when they transition from one stage to the next.
[*] Made Corridor of Shadows boss fight smaller.
[*] Boss spawns (turrets, landmines, etc.) now disappear when boss is defeated.
[/list]
[b]Giga Tank[/b]
[list]
[*] Giga Tank is now smaller and faster.
[*] Added a new attack that fires 3 smash attacks instead of one.
[*] Added a new attack where Giga Tank fires a flurry of laser bolts from its eye.
[*] Generally tuned logic for when Giga Tank fires certain attacks.
[/list]
[b]Chef Bot[/b]
[list]
[*] New VFX for spin attack
[*] Spin attack now makes Chef Bot invulnerable
[*] New knife/cleaver throwing patterns
[*] Chef Bot's throwing weapons are no longer stopped by bullets
[*] Chef Bot's throwing weapons are now disabled on death.
[/list]
[b]Knight Bot[/b]
[list]
[*] Added attack that spawns orbs that shoot projectiles.
[*] Made Dash attack less buggy.
[/list]
[b]Construction Bot[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new Sniper Turrets that have longer range and fire higher damage, faster projectiles.
[*] Fixed issue where Bully the bulldozer would sometimes pin player to the ground resulting in unfairly quick death.
[/list]
[b]Fahrenheit Maximus[/b]
[list]
[*] Made movement slightly faster
[*] Flamethrowers now deactivate on death
[*] Increased size of flamethrowers
[*] Some flamethrower attack patterns now rotate / spin
[*] Fahrenheit Maximus now leaves a burning trail behind it wherever it walks.
[/list]
[h2]Misc. tweaks and bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased Repair Kit option in the Maintenance center from 250 -> 300
[*] Replaced Repair Kits with Max Health powerups that give you 100 max health but don't heal.
[*] Grapple points now highlight when you are aimed point at them
[*] Shooting detonatables (grenades/rockets/etc) now causes them to explode
[*] Fixed snow launcher sound FX
[*] Increased Omnidrone attack range
[*] Fixed some lighting issues on some levels
[*] Increased the size of the Spin Spider hit box
[/list]

As always, thank you for playing and would love to hear from you in the [url=https://discord.gg/3egKhNg]Discord[/url]. If you have any friends who just got a headset for Christmas, sharing the game means a lot :)

Best,
Tadatoto

notes.title: Update: New stats system (Power/Processing/Durability) and melee weapon revamp
notes.content:
Hi all!

Hope you all are enjoying the holidays!

Have been trying to focus on polishing systems, new weapons, and new enemies.

[h2]Here's what's new[/h2]

[h3]New stats you can upgrade during runs[/h3]
This update adds 3 new upgradeable stats to help scale your build during your run. The new stats are:

[b]Power:[/b] Increases damage dealt by all weapons, powers, and utilities.

[b]Processing:[/b] Increases attack speed and crit rate. Decreases cooldowns and cast times.

[b]Durability:[/b] Increases max health, damage resistance, and smash attack damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/a38c8e81e6e79ead2115d211a9a889c95b5991c5.png[/img]

I'm planning to add some cards that scale uniquely with these stats in the future.

[h3]Upgrade kits[/h3]
To upgrade each of the stats above, you need to find Upgrade Kits, a new rare loot that drops from enemies and can be used to upgrade one of the three stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/e01c770e05fb62b4754404a825e17638b63f1798.png[/img]

[h3]Melee weapons are now gadgets[/h3]
Instead of cards, melee weapons are now gadgets that you can pick up and sheath/unsheath as much as you'd like without interrupting the flow of your card cycling.

Before this update, melee weapons were cards which felt bad because they interrupted the flow of your card cycling (since all other cards are ranged) and were very weak/risky due to their brief duration and requiring you to get so close to enemies.

I am finding them to be much more compelling as gadgets since you can actively choose to activate them and keep them active for as long as you like. I've reduced their damage a bit but overall they still pack quite a punch which I think is fair since they require you to get up close and personal.

[h3]Omnidrones join the fight![/h3]
I've been realizing that flying enemies present some unique challenges (they are strong counters to lots of heavy weapons) so I want to get more into the game. I also think they add a lot to the bullet hell pillar I'm working towards.

This update adds the Omnidrone which comes in three flavors - normal, rocket, and frost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/bb1a4382c27258c9a3bd852a07127a96dd50ac58.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/fa29d780f5c8a58368ad77af7e5a0f9272f3cdfc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/5b224c7ade7eb0976ccc0027a58ba251a66c14f2.png[/img]

[h3]Other stuff[/h3]
* Buffed bosses and enemies
* Reduced attack speed bonus from Adrenaline from 2x to 30%.
* Lots of fixes to bonus damage, perks, damage resistance, etc I found while working on the melee weapon revamp.
* Killed a lot of old code and tech debt.

Dev time is rare for me right now with the day job so trying to spend more time on dev and less on marketing/patch notes so I might have missed some stuff.

Plan for next few updates is to continue to focus on polish, new cards, and new enemies.

As always, would love to hear from you in the [url=http://discord.gg/XUABsDY]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Update: Grappling Gun and Reordering Weapon Cards
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Tadatoto here :3

Just letting you know I shipped a new update on Sunday. It adds a couple new gameplay features I am pretty psyched about.

[h1]What's New[/h1]

[h2]Grappling Gun Locomotion[/h2]
Shooting at Grapple Points will now deploy your Grapple, which can be used to swing or reel yourself towards the point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/44dc0b5e2998aa80d2df87332542c9c6c0024d0e.gif[/img]

This feature took quite a bit of experimenting. The system I found that I liked best works like this:
[list]
[*] Climbable objects now also serve as Grapple Points
[*] If you point at a Grapple Point and pull the trigger, instead of firing your cannon it will fire your Grapple (unless  there is something in the way like an enemy, obstacle etc).
[*] Once the Grapple has attached, your Booster button for that hand will reel in the Grapple instead of Boosting
[*] Releasing the trigger releases the Grapple
[*] Attaching to a Grapple Point re-ups your boosters same as landing
[*] While Grappled you can still use your other Booster to control your momentum
[/list]

I've retroactively added Grapple Points to some existing Rooms. Not every Room will have them, but I'm excited to see how I can use them going forward.

[h2]Reordering Weapon Cards[/h2]
You can now open your Operating System and rearrange the order of the Weapon Cards in your Library from any non-combat room.

This one is pretty self-explanatory, but was a much requested feature so I'm excited to ship-it :)

It's a big player buff, but I think it is worth it. It's a lot of fun being able to strategize around the sequencing of your Library.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dashing into a Grind Rail no longer sends you flying at absurd speeds.
[*] Fixed blur/screen tearing/double vision issue that was happening on some headsets after the last update added post-processing VFX.
[*] Made post-processing VFX enableable/disableable via the game menu
[*] Updated tutorial to include grappling and discuss card reordering
[*] Fixed issue where some enemies were spawning outside the Room on the Elite Waterworks Room.
[*] Made bullets strike Belly Bots more reliably (they were passing through sometimes due to bad collider setup)
[/list] 

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
Next I'll be focusing on
[list]
[*] The new Floor Type: Corridor of Shadows!
[*] New enemies and maybe a boss for Corridor of Shadows
[*] New narrative elements like NPCs, inspectable objects that reveal lore, etc.
[/list] 

Thanks and hope you are having fun!

As always, if you have any thoughts, questions, or issues, please don't hesitate to get in touch with me via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1255680/discussions/]Discussion Forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/7UU294F]Discord[/url].

Best,
Tadatoto

notes.title: Content Update: New Enemies, New Music, More Bullets
notes.content:
Howdy doody y'all,

Who likes new enemies? I like new enemies.

These are patch notes from the 12/8 Content Update!

[h2]Here's What's New[/h2]
[h3]7 New Practice Bots[/h3]
Scaling out enemies and bosses is a big priority on the [url=https://www.tadatoto.com/roadmap]Early Access Roadmap[/url].

This update adds 7 new enemies. I tried to ensure each of these new enemies contributes some new feel to the game. They each have unique quirks for you to learn and master.

I have also been leaning in more and more to the 3D bullet hell direction, so a lot of these enemies feature bullet hell inspired projectiles and attack patterns.

[h3]Bounce Bomber[/h3]
A tanky ranged enemy that fires bombs which bounce multiple times before exploding. The bouncing bombs introduce a little more chaos than your standard Grenadier bots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/8819916089d1d66737f2087b5abe107be04d3f40.png[/img]

[h3]Smallclops[/h3]
A tiny cyclops with a fighting spirit. Fires bullets at you from it's single eye.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/9999aba4751732a69446eae6c892daa1857ef3d9.png[/img]

[h3]Triclops[/h3]
A three-eyed bot that fires a spread of bullets at you from it's three eyes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/ac21b319a8c7a21d0a1c33235b79340253e4717e.png[/img]

[h3]Frostclops[/h3]
A many-eyed bot that fires a barrage of ricocheting bullets at you from it's array of eyes. The bullets ricochet off of nearby walls, ceilings, and floors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/cd9c4aacf4856e7b473250c781af2afa579e3c2d.png[/img]

[h3]Spin Spider[/h3]
A spider bot that spins constantly, firing bullets horizontally in all directions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/6f01a70e45812ae6a3d6adeb19220c6b0b8c86a1.png[/img]

[h3]Frost Spider[/h3]
A small spider that fires ricocheting bullets upward, such that they bounce off ceilings and back to floors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/2838990bcf382cf4df19d386ba07c4dfceaf248e.png[/img]

[h3]Bounce Spider[/h3]
A troublesome enemy. Spins and fires a barrage of bouncing bombs in all directions. Deal with these quick if you cross paths with one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/d5d932ee228d9974e796d7f77f3f0cdf62d394c9.png[/img]

[h3]New Exploration/Combat Soundtrack[/h3]
Currently some of the game's music was produced by me, and other tracks were licensed.

My end goal is to have strictly original soundtrack, but the music takes me a long time to produce as composition doesn't come so easy to me.

That said, I was able to produce a new soundtrack for the game's exploration/combat/climbing gameplay loop.

You can listen to it on Soundcloud or better yet, in game :)

[url=https://soundcloud.com/tadatoto/hand-cannon-virtuoso-climbers-edge]https://soundcloud.com/tadatoto/hand-cannon-virtuoso-climbers-edge[/url]

[h2]Feedback and Bug Fixes[/h2]
In addition to the new content above, I also fixed some bugs and addressed some player feedback:

[h3]Feedback[/h3]
The primary feedback addressed in the game this update has to do with combat feel and leaning into the game's direction as a 3D bullet hell.

I've gotten feedback previously that some of the enemys' projectiles are basically so fast that they are un-dodgeable for all intents and purposes.

I want the game to be hard, but not via a mechanism like un-dodgeable bullets which reduce your sense of agency as a player.

In this update I've taken steps to address that by:
[list]
[*] Reducing the set of enemy projectiles to a learnable set of visually distinct projectiles with consistent behavior - ex: Regular Bullets, Bouncing Bombs, Ricochet Bullets, Grenades, Void Blasts, etc.
[*] The idea here is that if a player sees a projectile, they can recognize it visually and expect it to behave a certain way which encourages player skill/learning.
[*] Many of the bullets (especially the Regular Bullets used by low-level enemies) are now slower and larger so you can see them more clearly and dodge them.
[*] Enemy projectiles can now be shot-cancelled by the player via their own projectiles, which I think is a satisfying new skill mechanic.
[/list]

I want to call out that this change to projectiles has made some parts of the game easier. Especially the early floors have become a bit easier since low-level enemies tend to use Regular Bullets which are now slower and can be shot-canceled by the player.

That said, I think long term the new bullet behavior will let me scale difficulty in other parts of the game via more interesting mechanisms (e.g. more complex bullet hell projectile patterns, more enemies shooting more bullets, faster projectiles like Void Blasts that only show up from high-level enemies, etc.)

Hope you have fun with some of these new behaviors and as always would love to hear what you think.

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed rail grinding while playing standing up, which was broken by the previous walking update.
[*] Fixed many bugs with the Spider Bots AI so that they now actually get aggroed and run at you and explode.
[/list]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
In addition to the above, I've been working on a free demo for the game to help more players try it out and grow the player base. It's going through the Steam review process this week. The next Content Update is scheduled for 12/16, so I'm hoping I'll be able to announce the demo then and share the game with a lot more players!

Thanks and hope you are having fun.

As always, if you have any thoughts, questions, or issues, please don't hesitate to get in touch with me via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1255680/discussions/]Discussion Forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/7UU294F]Discord[/url].

Thanks,
Tadatoto

notes.title: Content Update: Themed Floors (Part 1), Walking Locomotion, Elite Enemies + more
notes.content:
What's up Climbers :3

These are patch notes from Monday morning's Content Update!

Sorry it shipped a little late - ready for some cool stuff though?

[h2]Here's What's New[/h2]
[h3]Walking Locomotion[/h3]
Much requested feature - you can now use Walking Locomotion to control your movement more precisely while on the ground. Works with all controllers that have analog sticks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/f1ce39a639aa33a682b49cae3f7c8823825bf460.gif[/img]

As part of this update I also added some additional flavor to movement via skid sound effects that play when you skid to a halt and speed line visual effects that activate whenever you are moving fast in some direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/f23911f3357572b594b73b7262b4b613d6af53ef.gif[/img]

The only controller I'm not yet able to support Walking for is the Vive Wands. It's just pretty tricky due to the limited controller real estate (they just have the touchpads and not much in terms of utility buttons unfortunately).

Overall pretty happy with this feature, hope you like it.

[h3]Themed Floor System (Part 1)[/h3]
So Themed Floors were actually planned for much later in [url=https://www.tadatoto.com/roadmap]The EA Roadmap[/url], but for a number of reasons I found myself in a position where it made sense to take a first stab at things.

With this update, you'll find that you now encounter different [i]Floor Themes[/i] as you climb the tower. There are just two Floor Themes to start:

[b]The Waterworks[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/bb8267bd576aac9e7d86264fd29379cc5bb0181f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/99040e62579191c2428bb6691190bded5f4ef598.png[/img]

and [b]The Plaza[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/ec55a8b3730f224ceac3939666220fbd6602cd4c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/b711c3126625d6cf9682e56b0039e2fffb78c9e5.png[/img]

I ended up needing to add quite a few new rooms to flesh out The Waterworks, so incidentally [b]this update also contains quite a few new Room Types[/b] (probably like 8 I think? I haven't counted :)

I'm glad I got this first stab implemented because now it will make it much easier to add additional themes in subsequent updates (The Clockworks, The Foundry, etc. if you have any ideas let me know on [url=https://discord.gg/7UU294F]Discord[/url]!)

[h3]Elite Enemies[/h3]
There are now visually distinct and significantly stronger Elite versions of every enemy in the game. They are bigger, have more health, hit harder, and glow red.

Elite enemies have a chance to spawn in normal rooms and all enemies spawned during Elite Combat Tests are now Elite.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/76946ea0d45747f2b1598fc8d7db5f2ef173474a.png[/img]

[h2]Feedback and Bug Fixes[/h2]
In addition to the new content above, I also fixed some bugs and addressed some player feedback:

[h3]Feedback[/h3]
[list]
[*] Loading Screen between floors is now dark so it's easier on the eyes during evening play sessions.
[*] Added colliders to some things that were missing them for more solid feel.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Chef Bot boss battle is much less buggy.[/b]
[list]
[*] Chef Bot's Cleaver actually deals explosive damage now.
[*] Chef Bot's weapons actually stick in the walls.
[/list]
[*] Flamethrower/Freezethrower now damage all destructible objects (crates, grates, crystals, etc.)
[*] Mortar Bots now require line of sight to attack you.
[*] Fixed some z-fighting on doors throughout.
[*] Other stuff. It was a big update and I kind of lost track of what all I fixed to be honest lol.
[/list]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
The next Content Update is scheduled for 11/18. It may be a little on the lighter side since this one shipped later.

It will probably focus more on bug fixes and polish with some light content updates. Specifically:
[list]
[*] [b]Patching any issues with new content[/b] (walking locomotion, new levels, etc.)
[*] [b]Combat bug bashing[/b] (enemies shooting through wall, turrets not working reliably, etc.)
[*] If I do add new content, it will probably be [b]new ranged enemies[/b] with more varied projectile patterns and speeds (I think the game needs a dash more bullet hell, and would like some ranged enemies that give you more to think about than "oh this is another enemy that points and shoots fast/straight at me").
[/list]

Reminder that if you want early access to this content as it rolls in and are okay with the risk of some bugs, you can opt into the beta branch. I push new stuff to the beta branch as soon as it's basically done but it has a slightly higher risk of bugs. Otherwise you can stay on the default branch and get the less frequent but more stable bi-weekly updates.

You can opt into the beta branch by following these instructions in the Discord:
https://discordapp.com/channels/680320013831241731/694426975862915164/711485596614524928

Thanks and hope you are having fun.

As always, if you have any thoughts, questions, or issues, please don't hesitate to get in touch with me via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1255680/discussions/]Discussion Forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/7UU294F]Discord[/url].

Thanks,
Tadatoto

notes.title: Content Update! New Environments + Enemy, New Cards, Introducing Artifacts
notes.content:
Howdy Climbers 😤

Pushed the bi-weekly Content Update last night! Just posting notes now to let you all know what's new.

[h2]What's New[/h2]
[h3]Key Card Combat Tests + 4 New Rooms![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/736be06959fa565f9a37493ab4da212b0a7e5c28.png[/img]

This Content Update adds Key Card Combat Test - a new type of room that require you to fight enemies and find a Key Card to unlock the exit and proceed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/ec55a8b3730f224ceac3939666220fbd6602cd4c.png[/img]

There are 4 new Key Card rooms you can now encounter during your Climb. These 4 new rooms will fall under The Plaza floor theme once I move to the themed floor system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/b711c3126625d6cf9682e56b0039e2fffb78c9e5.png[/img]

I am pretty happy with how these rooms came together. They incorporate some new randomization logic so the enemies, key card, etc. aren't always in the same place. My level design chops are improving a bit as well, so I think they are more interesting to navigate than some of the existing rooms.

[h3]3 New Cards! Dynamo, Spare Magazine, and Pot Shot[/h3]
This Content Update also adds 3 new Weapon Cards. All 3 of these Cards are unlocked by default, so it should help increase the variety of Cards for first time players until they unlock more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/07b5175a522c4d7fefe4dc802c03ebc10bcc42c8.png[/img]

The new Cards are...

[b]Dynamo[/b]
An unrelenting engine - for those who can assemble it. Deals 10 damage and attacks 25% faster for each Dynamo in your Library. Damage scales with Card level.

[b]Spare Magazine[/b]
Your next card has 2X times as many Uses as it normally has. Spare Magazine does not stack. Multiplier scales with Card level.

[b]Pot Shot[/b]
The poor bot's grenade launcher. Gets the job done or your money back. Just kidding, you're stuck with it. Damage Scales with Card level.

Pot Shot is actually a lot of fun - it doesn't pack as much punch as the different Launchers you unlock later in the game, but it's a pretty fun early stage AOE Card :)

[h3]New Gameplay Element - Combat Artifacts[/h3]
Artifacts are a new gameplay element I'm introducing that will give you, the player, some sort of risk/reward decision. They show up in the middle of different Combat Tests and such and you can choose to activate them or ignore them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/a3b5cfa89915e581544c08b7a28578d85341be99.png[/img]

The first Artifacts I'm introducing are Combat Artifacts. If you choose to activate a Combat Artifact, you'll be blocked from exiting the current room until you defeat some amount of enemies at which point a Chest will drop with a reward such as a Card, Gadget, Stars, etc.

I have a bunch of different types of Artifacts I'm planning that I'll be introducing in subsequent Content Updates.

[h3]New Enemy - Turret Bots[/h3]
These won't be new to folks who have fought Construction Bot, but now they'll start showing up throughout the levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/11c6dc09e4eba412f40919311a345d0e380ee524.png[/img]

Turret Bots are mounted enemies that snipe at you from walls, ceilings, and other weird angles.

[h2]Feedback and Bug Fixes[/h2]
In addition to the new content above, I also fixed some bugs and addressed some player feedback:

[h3]Feedback[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some enemy projectiles are a little slower so active dodging plays can play more of a roll.
[*] Store Rooms are now more common so you have more opportunities to spend Bits.
[*] Flamethrower and Freezethrowers now have greater range (1.5X previous range). These cards feel a lot more useful now, I definitely find myself picking them up more often after this buff.
[*] Individual Booster is slightly more powerful now so you can fly a bit better with just one hand.
[*] Added some new stuff to tutorials regarding new Comfort Settings from last update.
[*] Reduced build size - the game was pretty big unnecessarily so I found ways to take it from ~3GB to ~2.4GB. There is room to reduce it further that I have planned which should also help performance.
[*] Reduced damage of Exploding Cubes so they are not a run ender anymore if you accidentally blow one up.
[*] Buffed Boxer Bot damage (since they fight so hard to get near you lol)
[*] Made view box for Cards/Gadgets/etc. bigger so the box doesn't disappear when you look up to read the text.
[*] Flamethrower is now unlocked by Default to increase early game Card variety.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed big bug from recent Content Update that was causing analog stick controller schemes to sometimes get stuck turning in circles (sorry about that).[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed bug where you would be shooting, look at an Interactable, and get stuck shooting.[/b]
[*] Fixed floor bug in Clockworks that prevented you from flying up from the water under the bridge.
[*] Fixed floor bug in Terrarium that prevented you from flying after landing on Rocks/pipes on side of map.
[*] Fixed Turrets/Barriers to actually fix in place when deploying instead of sliding around.
[*] Fixed melee weapons (like Phantom Fists and Energy Hammer) to be smashable against the floor.
[*] Fixed bug where Flamethrowers/Freezethrowers were not damaging Crystals.
[*] Fixed some cases where enemies were shooting through walls (still some work to do here).
[*] Fixed some cases where Turrets were failing to acquire targets (still some work to do here).
[/list]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
The next Content Update is scheduled for 11/04. I may ship a Patch between now and then.

This next Content Update will focus on:
* The last piece of the Locomotion system I want in place - some sort of short distance dash movement on the ground via analog stick
* New content from the [url=https://tadatoto.com/roadmap]Early Access Roadmap[/url] (New Cards, New Rooms, New Enemies).

Reminder that if you want early access to this content as it rolls in and are okay with the risk of some bugs, you can opt into the beta branch. I push new stuff to the beta branch as soon as it's basically done but it has a slightly higher risk of bugs. Otherwise you can stay on the default branch and get the less frequent but more stable bi-weekly updates.

You can opt into the beta branch by following these instructions in the Discord:
https://discordapp.com/channels/680320013831241731/694426975862915164/711485596614524928

Thanks and hope you are having fun.

As always, if you have any thoughts, questions, or issues, please don't hesitate to get in touch with me via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1255680/discussions/]Discussion Forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/7UU294F]Discord[/url].

Thanks,
Tadatoto

notes.title: Content Update! Comfort Settings, Launch Feedback, New Stuff, and Beta Branch.
notes.content:
Howdy All 👍

Today I pushed the first Content Update of Early Access.

Given this is the first updates since launch, it focuses on addressing post-launch feedback more than new game content like Cards and Environments.

That said, Cards, Environments, Enemies, etc. remain a major focus of Content Updates in the near future, as noted in the [url=https://tadatoto.com/roadmap]Early Access Roadmap[/url].

[h2]New Stuff[/h2]
[h3]More Comfortable by Default[/h3]
There were a few controller settings, display features, etc. that I'd gotten enough feedback on that it was a no brainer to just add/update them. Specifically:
[list]
[*] [b]WMR controllers can now snap turn using analog sticks.[/b]
[*] Index controller defaults just more comfy than they were (grip boosters less sensitive by default, touchpad no longer causes sporadic turning). Still need some work on climbing.
[*] Main Display now follows player's HMD instead of their hands.
[/list]
[h3]Comfort Settings[/h3]
In addition to making the default controls/settings more comfortable, players can now customize much more based on their personal preferences.

Players can now...
[list]
[*] Choose between [b]Smooth turning and Snap turning[/b]
[*] [b]Adjust Turning Speed[/b] (or set it to zero to disable turning altogether)
[*] [b]Adjust how sensitive their Boosters are to Grip force[/b] (or disable Grip to Boost altogether in favor of the alternate Booster button). Especially handy for controllers like Index with high grip sensitivity.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/000d1b7d7731b4b0f5ba1500cd8380ade6ea93db.png[/img]

Players can also now...
[list]
[*] [b]Allocate additional booster strength to a hand of their choosing[/b] (for instance, if you prefer to fly with your left hand and shoot with your right).
[*] [b]Invert their Boosters[/b] in favor of Boosters that push you away from where you point them.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/69ea9c43b504e00f38750b18ff19418329323a3c.png[/img]

Finally, players can..
[list]
[*] Not new, but can still choose to control Booster direction via HMD instead of hands. I have found this option is further improved by the increased customization around turning - specifically being able to choose your preferred mechanism and increase turning speed helps with HMD based movement.
[*] Choose if they want their Main Display (Health, Ammo, current card, etc.) to tracks their head (new default based on feedback) or their hands (the old way).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/7b05966ec014c025c3beca3b806bd47e3f08a764.png[/img]
[h3]Updated Tutorial[/h3]
Already posted about this one so won't go into too much detail. I updated the tutorial two days after launch based on early feedback that it had too much reading. I think it's a lot more fun and interactive now 👍 you can read more in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1255680/view/2891831951591949532]these patch notes[/url].

[h3]New Room - The Clockworks[/h3]
There's a new room in town! It's the first in a series for one of the new themed Floor Types I will be working towards as described in the [url=https://www.tadatoto.com/roadmap]Early Access Roadmap[/url].

This one is the first from a new Floor Type I'm planning called The Clockworks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/fd5da56d1fe5618bc5d7793bb7870477f9c27da4.png[/img]

The Clockworks are much more dynamic than previous environments I've made, with moving parts and ambient noise work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/e06e13b0b76b08a90687a32e4f36f5f5d786994a.png[/img]

This specific new room I've added is also the first of a new Room Type I'll be adding more of, which are non-elite Combat Tests that require you to clear enemies (to mitigate the current passivity meta which is not that fun).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/cd2331744cec2da8268ca310216192591d40024b.png[/img]

[h3]New Card - Adrenaline[/h3]
I also snuck a new Weapon Card into this update.

[b]Adrenaline[/b]
Attack and Move Speed 2X for _ seconds after activation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/da0fabc42a14abefa8d81e1cb56c7ecd4038d1d1.png[/img]

Adrenaline is a new Power Card that temporarily increases your Attack Speed and Move Speed (think of it as a playable version of the Overclock powerup). It can really spice up a quick burning deck and makes a great compliment to Rage.

I'm excited to add more Cards in near future updates that add more and more deck building strategy to the game.

[h2]Bug Fixes and Feedback[/h2]
In addition to the new functionality above, I also fixed some bugs and addressed some additional feedback:

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemy health scales faster now with each floor to mitigate some steam rolling that was occurring too reliably.
[*] Level IV Cards are much rarer now.
[/list]
[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug that was preventing game data from loading in some countries due to dotnet localization issues.
[*] Fixed bug where it was possible to run out of boost and land on the palette in the tutorial which would not recharge your Boosters.
[*] Fixed bug where talking to Gun Gun Metal on the first day and moving through the door while he was still talking would freeze the loading screen.
[/list]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
The next Content Update is scheduled for 10/21. It will focus primarily on new Environments and new Cards.

[b]One thing I've been thinking is that I want a way to get new content out faster for players who want a faster update pace and are willing to tolerate the occasional bug or issue.[/b]

I don't want people to have to wait 2 weeks if they want stuff sooner than that.

To that end, I'm starting a new practice where I will just push updates to the beta branch as soon as they are ready to go.

The idea is if you want more rapidly changing content at risk of some bugs, you can opt into the beta branch. Otherwise you can stay on the default branch and get the less frequent but more stable bi-weekly updates.

You can opt into the beta branch by following these instructions in the Discord:
https://discordapp.com/channels/680320013831241731/694426975862915164/711485596614524928

Thanks and hope you are having fun.

As always, if you have any thoughts, questions, or issues, please don't hesitate to get in touch with me via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1255680/discussions/]Discussion Forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/7UU294F]Discord[/url].

Thanks,
Tadatoto

notes.title: Patch! New Tutorial - More Doing, Less Reading
notes.content:
Do you know who likes reading walls of text?

Pretty much nobody, I think lol.

[b]Some great initial feedback I got was that the game's tutorial requires way too much reading.

I think this feedback was spot on, so I reworked the tutorial yesterday and just pushed an update.[/b]

The new tutorial focuses on learning by doing rather than reading. There is still some reading, but the "time to fun" is much shorter now and you'll get jump into some light action pretty quickly.

[h2]Some fun facts about the new the tutorial:[/h2]

[h3]The Orientation Instructor is no more.[/h3]
Sorry if you liked him talking your ear off, but alas he has retired. Don't worry though, there are many other Helper Bots to meet throughout The Academy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/95b5b98d0236cf63c11bb804d16cc843730f8a68.png[/img]

[h2]This update cut about 1500 words or about 5 minutes of reading I'd estimate.[/h2]
It's miles, miles better and now I feel like a crazy person for having it the way it was, so thank you again for that feedback. This is exactly the sort of stuff I was hoping to get out of Early Access.

[h2]You now get to practice using your Boosters and fighting your first enemies in a safe environment.[/h2]
I think this is better not just because it's more fun, but also because it provides a better warm-up for the pace of the actual game so that you are not as caught off guard by the difficulty during your first run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/7941e9df1951488c3d24062ac7288738d1a7d8af.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/144d2a2448bb43b5c31363362a42d0afc7846492.png[/img]

[b]Anyways, this new version of the tutorial is now live[/b], so you should have an update queued on Steam. Honestly I like it so much more than the old version that it might even be fun to replay it and see what's changed if you already played through the Orientation Instructor version.

I've bug bashed the new tutorial on all supported headsets but if you run into any issues or any parts are confusing please let me know via [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1255680/discussions/]the Steam forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/XUABsDY]the Discord[/url]. I am around all weekend to quickly resolve any issues 👍

Thank you again, hope you have fun.

- Tadatoto

notes.title: Content Update! Crystal Trials 💎 The Infirmary 🏥 and Balance ⚖️
notes.content:
Hey gang!

Just shipped the 09-27 Content Update 👍

[b]This was the last pre-Early Access Content Update![/b]

Early Access for Hand Cannon Virtuoso will go live this Wednesday 09/30 at around 12pm PST!

Can't thank all of you who took time out of your lives to try the beta enough - your support has been extremely motivating and the game is going into Early Access in great shape as a result of your feedback. If you've been enjoying the beta and know anyone at all who you think might be interested, spreading the word about launch is a great way to support the game!

Anyways, here's what's new:

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[h3]New Death/Respawn Experience: The Infirmary[/h3]
The Infirmary was the last bit of the core gameplay loop I really wanted to get in before Early Access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/fe8657faa1905f0be39de1333bd922be5ac6d329.png[/img]

Basically, The Infirmary is an end-of-run experience that clarifies [b]how you performed[/b] (end of run stats pertaining to total run time, floors cleared, resources collected, etc.), [b]what you earned[/b] (e.g. communicating if you unlocked new Cards or if not how many more Stars you need), and [b]what you can do next[/b] (start a new climb or go back to The Lobby).

I'm hoping The Infirmary will make the core gameplay loop clearer and more rewarding for players, giving you a clear sense of how your actions are contributing to your progression.

[h3]New Room Type: Crystal Trials![/h3]
One of my core goals for Content Updates is to continuously expand the variety challenges you need to overcome.

This Content Update adds a new type of Combat Test where you must destroy an energy crystal that is guarded by enemies. The longer you linger, the more powerful the crystal grows, firing ever more powerful blasts of energy in your direction.

I hope you have a blast with this new room type. It appears as both a Regular and Elite Combat Test. If you have ideas for additional room types you'd like to see please send them my way in [url=discord.gg/XUABsDY]the Discord[/url].

[h3]New Skill Mechanics: Enemies take more damage based on where you shoot them[/h3]
Headshots now deal more damage to all enemies! Arms/Legs deal less damage. Chest shots deal normal damage. Adds more skill to gameplay I think, really enjoying it so far.

[h3]New Visual Design for Cards[/h3]
Cards now actually look like uh...Cards. I hope this adds to the deck building feel of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/b8397125be03e70a6d4c17a2b051aa3e25cd789a.png[/img]

[h1]Feedback and Bugs Fixed[/h1]
Aside from new content, this update has balance work, bug fixes, and polish. Much of the changes are based on great feedback from Discord community members playing the beta, so a big thank you to those folks.

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Buffed Pistol Shot
[*] Floor 1 is a _lot_ easier
[*] Balanced drop rates of Cards based on Floor (no more Floor 1 Legendary shotguns)
[*] Relaxed damage scaling for all floors (Floor 2 enemies should no longer 1 shot you :)
[*] Boss fight wins drop more stars the higher you climb.
[*] Removed stupidly unfair Elite Combat Test room with a tiny platform and lava.
[*] Nerfed Sniper and Leprechaun a bit.
[*] Decreases cast time for powers (Rage, Molten Core, etc.)
[*] Made Perfect Processing and Overclock rarer.
[/list]
[h3]Polish[/h3]
[list]
[*] Comfort: Adds option to control Booster Direction via HMD instead of hands.
[*] Comfort: Adds optional non-grip button for Booster thrust to all controllers (for users who prefer that to grip).
[*] Made exploding cubes look more dangerous so less people blow themselves up.
[*] Adds delay before Bosses start attacking you
[*] Enemies stop attacking you after you die.
[*] Pistol Shot no longer drops as a reward
[*] Makes the orientation video skippable when starting a new game.
[*] Reduces knockback from enemy explosives
[*] Adds some new tips to loading screens
[*] Adds courtesy warning screen for players first booting the game.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix bug that was causing unintentional scene changes on WMR.
[*] Fixes Engineer Perk
[*] Fixed bug that was allowing enemies to shoot under ramp in one room.
[*] You can no longer Dash after you die.
[*] Fixes bug that was causing music tracks to fail to play when cross fading.
[*] Fixes bug causing unlocking Phantom Fists to fail
[*] Fixes lighting issues in loading screen
[*] Fixes some, but not all, issues with turrets.


[/list]

[h1]How to Play[/h1]
Wishlist the game and snag a copy when Early Access launch starts on 09/30! I'd love to hear what you think and hope you enjoy it as much as I enjoy hacking on the game. Just remember the game is in Early Access, so if that's not your style you might prefer to hold off for the full 1.0 release about a year from now. That said, grabbing a copy during Early Access will help support continued development and enable me to make the game a lot better by listening to and incorporating your feedback.

If you do snag a copy be sure to join [url=discord.gg/XUABsDY]the Discord[/url]. Feel free to DM me (@Tadatoto) - I'd love to hear what you think and am available to help if you run into any issues.

Next up is a Patch with pre-launch bug fixes/polish before 09/30.

Next Content Update will ship ~2 weeks from now, 10/07.

notes.title: Content Update! New Weapons🤺 Skill Tests 🤻 and Index Support 🥽
notes.content:
What's up party people 🥳

I shipped the 09-09 Content Update last night, should be queued next time you open Steam 👍

Per the #dev-schedule channel in [url=https://discord.gg/XUABsDY]the Discord[/url], these Content Updates ship every other Wednesday and Patches ship as soon as they are ready. The main difference is that [b]Content Updates[/b] will always have new content (levels, weapons, enemies, etc.) whereas [b]Patches[/b] may just be bug fixes/addressing quick feedback/etc.

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[h3]Valve Index Support![/h3]
Self-explanatory - my Index controllers got here and I was finally able to add Index support to the game :D Huge thank you to the Index beta testers who helped me test drive things!

[h3]6 New Weapon Cards![/h3]
[list]
[*] Phantom Fists - Conjures ethereal fists that deliver powerful AOE smash attacks.
[*] Laser Cannon - Chargeable laser blast that blows away your opponents.
[*] Freeze Ray - Zaps enemies with a frosty bolt.
[*] Snow Launcher - Launches globs of liquid nitrogen at your opponents. Brrr!
[*] Frost Rockets - Hope your enemies like it cold!
[*] Sludge Rockets - Blasts your enemies with corrosive sludge missiles.
[/list]

My favorite new Weapon Cards from this batch are the Phantom Fists and Laser Cannon :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/e011659dff5340b9685ace044d22cd1c34c9b480.gif[/img]

[h3]New Room Type: Skill Tests![/h3]
Skill Tests are a new type of room that will now show up as you climb The Academy. Skill Tests stress skills like platforming and target shooting rather than combat. These new rooms help to change up pacing a bit but are much rarer than Combat Tests - the focus of the game remains combat.

This Content Update add 4 new Skill Tests but there will be many more to come in the future!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/529e6e878c448405ee3d05be23c289bbe174958f.gif[/img]

[h1]Feedback and Bugs Fixed[/h1]
Aside from new content, this update has balance work, bug fixes, and polish. Much of the changes are based on great feedback from Discord community members playing the beta, so a big thank you to those folks.

[h3]Feedback and Polish[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Reorganized HUD to make health more visible[/b]. Just moved Health display down to same spot as Ammo display. Less confusing to have them in the same spot.
[*] [b]Added enemy knockback[/b] via melee weapons, explosives, and swatting them away with your hand cannons.
[*] [b]Reduced Giga Tank's AOE[/b]
[*] [b] Added arrows to make objectives more clear[/b] during tutorial etc.
[*] Added last + next Content Update dates to main menu.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made it so same exact room will not repeat itself on the same floor.
[*] Fixed edge case where replacing cards would fail sometimes.
[*] Relaxed grip threshold for grabbing (was impacting some older controllers, like original Knuckles).
[/list]

[h1]How to Play the Content Update[/h1]
If you want to play new content as Content Updates ship, join [url=discord.gg/XUABsDY]the Discord[/url] and DM me (@Tadatoto) for a Beta Key. I'll be winding down the beta leading up to Early Access.

Hope you are able to take the update for a spin! If you do, I'd love to hear what you think. If you run into any issues please don't hesitate to @ me in the Discord.

notes.title: Content Update! 🔫 Unlockable Weapons/Gadgets ⚔️
notes.content:
Howdy all 🤠

I shipped the new Content Update last night, there should be an update queued next time you open Steam 👍

Per the #dev-schedule channel in [url=https://discord.gg/XUABsDY]the Discord[/url], these Content Updates ship every other Wednesday and Patches ship as soon as they are ready. The main difference is that [b]Content Updates[/b] will always have new content (levels, weapons, enemies, etc.) whereas [b]Patches[/b] may just be bug fixes/addressing quick feedback/etc

[h2]TL;DR - New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Added an actual ending[/b]  if you clear the tower :)
[*][b] You now unlock Weapons/Gadgets gradually[/b] by collecting stars
[*] [b]Added 2 new Combat Modules[/b]
[*] [b]New Weapon Card: Sonic Waves[/b] - cuts through multiple enemies with soothing sound waves
[*] [b]Relaxed difficulty curve[/b] based on beta feedback (first floor should be less intimidating now)
[/list]

Here's a fun GIF of the new Weapon Card - Sonic Waves:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37075843/ffdb7e22e4910056537ab0c2826a2ff21c39bf18.gif[/img]

[h2]How to Play the Content Update[/h2]
[b]If you want to play new content as Content Updates ship, [url=https://discord.gg/XUABsDY]join the Discord[/url] and DM me (@Tadatoto) for a Beta Key.[/b]

Aside from new content, this update has a lot of balance work, bug fixes, and polish. Much of the changes are based on great feedback from Discord community members playing the beta, so a big thank you to those folks.

[h2]Polish/Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Recalibrated aiming reticules/crosshairs to be more accurate
[*] Lowered health and damage of Floor 1 enemies - difficulty scales more slowly.
[*] Lowered health of Floor 1 bosses - they were too tanky. Might still need lowered
[*] Increased range of your turrets
[*] Grenade enemies knock you back less
[*] Elite Combat Challenges now have less enemies spawned at a slower rate
[*] Lava Elite Combat Challenge relaxed - less enemies, bigger stage to fight on.
[*] Relaxed burn damage so it's less punishing
[*] Weapon drop rates modified so powerful stuff drops later
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Smash attacks now smash through enemies instead of getting canceled if you land directly on an enemy
[*] Some lighting that was messed up rebaked
[*] Fixed poison/effect VFX on drones
[/list]

Hope you are able to take the update for a spin! If you do, I'd love to hear what you think. If you run into any issues please don't hesitate to @ me in the Discord.

Next up is a Patch with bug fixes/polish I'll try to get out in the next few days.

Next Content Update will ship 2 weeks from now, 09/09
